column1: # Proto-SOUTHERN-Min GOLD (Kwok 2018) — a DIFFERENT, shallower node than Norman's
# Proto-Min: ancestor of the Southern Min branch only (Hokkien/Teochew/Hainanese/
# Leizhou), NOT the whole Min family. Notation: IPA + trailing tone digit 1-8.
# Harvested verbatim from en.wiktionary Appendix:Proto-Southern Min reconstructions
# (CC BY-SA), which lists Kwok (2018:180-203). Use as a SCALE reference for rhyme/
# nucleus triangulation; coda/nasal differences vs the MC-anchored reconstructor are
# EXPECTED (Southern Min innovated -ʔ codas & nasal vowels). Never edit by hand to
# 'fix' a score. notes = full reconstruction incl. ~variants.
